## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `feature/…`, `fix/…`, `docs/…` or `chore/…` and targets `main`
- [ ] `pytest` and `ruff check . && ruff format --check .` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated (none touch the network)
- [ ] README / `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` updated if behavior or modules changed
- [ ] New user-visible text has keys in both `i18n/en.py` and `i18n/tr.py`
